iti13:1.1: 3 vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttamarahatāti me sutaṃ
iti13:2.1: makkhaṃ bhikkhave anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ tattha cittaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya
iti13:2.2: makkhañca kho bhikkhave abhijānaṃ parijānaṃ tattha cittaṃ virājayaṃ pajahaṃ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāyāti.
iti13:4.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutanti.
